artworks.title: Italian Peasant Woman
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her body slightly turned to the side. Her left hand rests on her hip, and her right hand is placed on a basket on a low wall or table. She has a contemplative expression, with her gaze directed downward. Her facial features are detailed but obscured by shadows and the illustration style. Her hair is covered with a cloth or hood that drapes around her head and shoulders. She is wearing a long, flowing dress with a belt tied around her waist, suggested by folds and creases in the fabric. The setting is simple with a neutral background. There are no visible jewelry or notable objects except for the basket.

artworks.title: Alpine Landscape
artworks.medium: aquatint and etching printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rugged terrain, architectural elements, and natural features. The view is from an elevated perspective, showcasing distant hills, castles, and a sepia-toned color palette. The painting features intricate detailing of rocky outcrops and architectural stonework, with a castle-like structure on the right, surrounded by trees and a winding pathway. Smaller buildings and towers dot the landscape, leading to hills under a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after German or Netherlandish 16th century
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped figures around a cross. The piece shows multiple figures gathered around a large cross structure, with at least one figure descending from it, assisted by others on ladders, while more figures surround and support below. The attire consists of flowing classical robes, adding texture and depth to the image. The tones are sepia, giving an aged, vintage feel. The composition and use of light create a striking contrast, drawing attention to the central figures and their actions.

artworks.title: Retour de Nour(r)ice (Return from the Wet Nurse)
artworks.artist: François Hubert, after Jean-Baptiste Greuze, published by Jacques-Firmin Beauvarlet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals in a room. The central figure is a seated woman embracing a child who is leaning towards her. Another woman is also with a child. Several children are close by, with a man standing to the right holding a large piece of fabric. There is a hunting dog nearby. The room has wooden beams on the ceiling and a plain wall. A platter is on the floor.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, laid down on a mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene featuring a stone basin. The image includes classical elements, a plaque with inscriptions "Recueil de Desseins" and "1784," two figures at a basin adorned with a lion's head, architectural elements like columns with circular decorations, a large vase, classical machinery, foliage extending from the left, and a pedestal with a small figure. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing texture and ornamentation.

artworks.title: Anacreon
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of classical figures in an architectural setting. The artwork features several figures, including a semi-nude woman and a reclining, bearded older man who is partially naked. The woman is holding a bowl up to the man's mouth in a nurturing gesture. Surrounding them are child-like figures, some with wings. The background includes architectural elements like columns and a sweeping architectural structure. The use of shading and line work highlights the flowing garments and emotive expressions of the figures. The composition is dynamic and full of movement, reminiscent of Baroque or Rococo styles, emphasizing movement and grandeur.

artworks.title: Composition with Antique Fragments
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays several ornate objects, including large urns and vessels adorned with detailed human and mythical figures. The color palette consists of various shades of sepia, rendering the image in a monochromatic brown tone. In the foreground, a large urn is tilted with its detailed carvings visible, and a helmet with a plume lies nearby. A decorative column stands with a carved face medallion, while in the background, foliage decorates the space behind a large, elevated bowl. An amphora with a detailed figure leans against a column-like structure, next to another pot patterned with intricate designs.

artworks.title: Composition with Antique Vases
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several large classical vases and urns with intricate designs, relief sculptures of figures, and decorative motifs. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones with variations in brown shades. A large urn is positioned centrally, slightly left from center, with a pedestal adorned with sculpted figures in the foreground. A smaller urn is displayed on a wall niche in the upper right. A large, embellished urn with climbing vines is in the upper center. Other urns and vases, some with figurative depictions, are in the lower right section, and decorative remnants are scattered on the right edge.

artworks.title: Composition with Antiquities
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: There is a large ornate vase with intricate detailing and handles, and a decorative shield with a detailed floral and face motif in the image. The color palette consists of shades of black and white. The vase displays a figure that appears to be a woman with extended arms. The shield is positioned leaning against the vase. A cherub figure is on a decorative element to the right, and there is a faint scenic background behind the objects.

artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative frieze featuring cherubic figures, ornate foliage, and classical elements. The central design includes a large urn, winged putti holding garlands, and cherubs surrounded by acanthus leaves and flowers. Delicate curves and scrolls fill the background, adding to the image’s symmetry and balance. Shading and light give the drawing depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative frieze featuring cherubic figures and floral motifs. It shows a detailed ornamental design with cherub-like figures among scrolls and floral garlands. The central vase is surrounded by symmetrical arrangements of flowers and acanthus leaves. The cherubs are interacting with the decorative elements in a classical or baroque style.

artworks.title: Composition with Figural Relief
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman with a cherubic figure. The woman stands against a textured background facing the cherub. She has a serene expression, delicate features, and styled hair. She is draped in classical clothing, holding a cornucopia. The cherub reaches up toward the woman with outstretched arms and wings. There is a podium-like structure nearby in a leafy environment with detailed foliage and branches.

artworks.title: The Death of Hector on the Ramparts of Troy (recto) / Tancred and Erminia (verso)
artworks.medium: aquatint with etching printed in gray-brown on laid paper; aquatint printed in sepia on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people surrounding a draped figure. The scene is monochromatic, using shades of brown. The figures appear to be a mix of genders and ages, with some seated and others standing. The background shows a stone wall and archway. The emotions conveyed by the figures range from empathy and reverence to grief.

artworks.title: The Dictation
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, depicted from head to knee, seated close to each other. The woman sits on the left, slightly turned towards the man, with her head resting on her hand as she gazes downward. Her facial features are softly defined and she wears a headscarf that partially covers her long hair. She is dressed in a long gown with voluminous sleeves. The man, seated on the right, leans towards a table while writing with a quill on a sheet of paper. His face, seen in profile, exhibits sharp features framed by wavy hair and an elaborate hat adorned with large feathers. His attire is loose-fitting, with a cloak or coat that falls around him in gentle folds. The table between them holds an ink pot. The background is simple, with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Tancred and Erminia
artworks.artist: Pierre Lelu, after Charles-Paul-Jean-Baptiste de Bourgevin Vialart de Saint-Morys
artworks.medium: aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped figures. The central focus is on two figures kneeling beside a reclining form wrapped in cloth. The composition includes lush, leafy trees in the background. The work employs a monochrome sepia tone. The figures are rendered with a soft touch.

artworks.title: Allegory of Conception or  Allegory of Redemption
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in red-brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in various poses. At the top, a central figure is seated and surrounded by cherubic figures with wings. The central figure has soft facial features, wavy hair, and wears flowing clothing. The cherubs are depicted in dynamic poses. Below, numerous men are shown in classical robes, some seated, others standing or reclining. They are gesturing upwards towards the central figure. The background consists of swirling clouds and rays of light, while the lower portion shows sparse foliage. The scene appears to depict a narrative.

artworks.title: Allegory Celebrating the Birth of the Duc d’Enghien
artworks.artist: Louis-Gabriel Monnier, after Charles-Joseph Le Jolivet
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an oval composition framed by text. In the center, there is a youthful figure on a platform with a crown, holding an olive branch. Flanking the central figure are two draped female forms interacting with a shield inscribed with historical battles. Architectural motifs and inscriptions below add to the grandeur and historical context.

artworks.title: The Ascension of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Johann Gottlieb Prestel, after Lodovico Carracci (formerly attributed to Guido Reni)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper, laid down on Liechtenstein album page
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to plate): 68.7 × 40.6 cm (27 1/16 × 16 in.)
mount: 74.5 × 51 cm (29 5/16 × 20 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a central figure surrounded by winged cherubs and angels lifting the figure up. Additional figures in robes gesture towards the scene. Classical architecture is visible in the background. This painting is in the style of Guido Reni.

artworks.title: Concert des Anges autour de l'enfant Jesus (Concert of Angels around the Infant Jesus)
artworks.artist: Charles-Paul-Jean-Baptiste de Bourgevin Vialart de Saint-Morys, after Paolo Veronese
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central scene. The composition depicts several figures engaged in what appears to be an offering or reverence scene, centered around a woman holding an infant. The background includes architectural elements, such as columns and arched windows, as well as branches of a tree extending into the top right of the image. Two of the figures are holding musical instruments. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic palette, using shades of brown and fine, detailed linework to create depth and texture. The figures display a dynamic array of gestures and postures.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.artist: Charles-Paul-Jean-Baptiste de Bourgevin Vialart de Saint-Morys, after Sandro Botticelli
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in red-brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person's face, captured in a forward-facing position with their head slightly turned to the left. The illustration includes the head, a small portion of the neck, and shoulders. The person has deep-set eyes, a straight nose, slightly parted lips, and wavy or curly hair partially covered by a cloth or head covering. The artwork is in a sepia wash with cross-hatching lines for light and shadow. There are no jewelry or objects in the image, and the background is a plain, uniform color.

artworks.title: Pensionnaires de l’Académie allants de Rome à Naples par le procaccio et passants pendant la nuit la forest de fondi (Pensionnaires from the French Academy Going from Rome to Naples by Carriage and Passing through a Forest in Fondi during the Night)
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Gabriel François Doyen
artworks.medium: aquatint and etching printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man near a large carriage with oversized wheels. The horizon line is not clear, and the focus is on the man and the carriage under shadowy trees. The scene is in sepia tones, emphasizing light and shadow. The brushstrokes are subtle, creating smooth transitions between shades. The color palette is limited to various shades of brown. Trees form a backdrop, and the path is depicted in lighter tones, emphasizing the man and the carriage.

artworks.title: Naiads and Tritons
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures lounging in nature. The image depicts a group of figures reclining on a natural surface, surrounded by lush foliage and a waterfall in the background. The scene is filled with movement and interaction, emphasizing a playful or serene moment in a mythical setting. The drawing uses shades of brown to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Entrance of the Temple of Serapis at Pozzuoli
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene with a grand building to the left, adorned with a statue. Steps lead up to the building. In the distance, columns suggest classical architecture, surrounded by foliage. The painting style is detailed, capturing light and shadow on the surfaces and greenery. The color palette is sepia-toned. People are seen on the steps. The sky has clouds.

artworks.title: View in the Garden of a Roman Villa, with the Temple of Hercules Victor and the Temple of Portunus
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image showcases a historical architectural scene with a round building featuring ornate columns, arches with statues, people engaged in daily activities, and potted plants. In the background, there is a row of trees, a cloudy sky, and a smaller structure with a dog nearby. The artwork is primarily in brown monochrome with variations in shading, creating texture in the stone surfaces and vegetation. The color palette consists of sepia tones, resembling antique etchings.
